Chandler pickups, from Ocotillo to Historic Downtown

Scottsdale Sprinters is a Scottsdale chauffeured transportation company serving metro Phoenix. Chandler splits neatly in two for us: the tech corridor in West Chandler around Ocotillo and the Price Corridor campuses, which books corporate and airport work on weekdays, and Historic Downtown and the south — Sun Lakes, Fulton Ranch, Chandler Heights — which books tours, celebrations and weekend groups.

How we work in Chandler

Chandler is where a mid-size vehicle earns its place. Groups here are usually eight to thirteen people heading out together — a team dinner in Historic Downtown, a brewery or wine run, a milestone birthday — and they want one vehicle that waits rather than a convoy that splits up at the first stop.

Where we pick up in Chandler

We pick up across West Chandler around Ocotillo and the Price Corridor, Central Chandler near Historic Downtown, and South Chandler through Sun Lakes, Riggs Road, Fulton Ranch, Andersen Springs and Clemente Ranch. Sky Harbor and Phoenix-Mesa Gateway are both in normal range.

Frequently asked questions

Do you do weekday corporate runs in West Chandler?

Yes. The Ocotillo and Price Corridor campuses are regular weekday work — airport transfers, client pickups and team dinners, booked by the hour so the vehicle waits rather than leaving and coming back.

Can you run a brewery or wine tour out of Chandler?

Yes. You book the vehicle for the hours you need and set the stops; we do not sell fixed packages. Passengers 21 and over may drink on board in a vehicle for hire, and the chauffeur never does.

Which parts of Chandler do you serve?

All of it — West Chandler and Ocotillo, Central Chandler and Historic Downtown, and South Chandler including Sun Lakes, Fulton Ranch and Chandler Heights.

What size group fits best from Chandler?

Most Chandler bookings are eight to thirteen people, which fits a limo Sprinter comfortably. Larger groups move to a party bus and smaller ones to the Luxury SUV (Suburban) — the reservations team sizes it against your headcount before you pay.
